title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.21496v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. translated_title: 视觉-语言-动作模型中陈述性知识与程序性知识的解耦
translated_abstract: 在现实世界中部署通用机器人智能体需要可迁移的技能。具体而言，通过物体特定演示训练来克隆行为的策略必须能够超越该物体进行泛化，否则数据收集需求将变得难以承受。近年来，对预训练的数十亿参数视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行微调——首先在大规模机器人数据集上进行，然后在较少的场景特定演示上进行——已成为设计视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的主流范式。虽然这些策略在分布内实现了最先进的操作性能，但它们对微小的空间、语义和任务变化仍然十分脆弱。在这项工作中，我们针对当前模型无法将参数中编码的陈述性知识（即概念和实体语义）与程序性知识（即如何执行某项操作）解耦的问题进行研究，这是……的一个根本性瓶颈。
tldr: 该论文指出现有视觉-语言-动作模型无法将陈述性知识（概念与实体语义）与程序性知识（操作方法）解耦，导致其对空间、语义和任务变化十分脆弱、难以泛化到训练物体之外，这是通用机器人技能迁移的根本瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the inability of current Vision-Language-Action models to decouple declarative knowledge (concepts and entity semantics) from procedural knowledge (how to perform actions) as a fundamental bottleneck that makes them brittle to spatial, semantic, and task variations and prevents generalization beyond training objects.
